description: Scans .ts and .html files (or a directory) for Angular Reactive Forms constructs and classifies each finding as "mechanical" (safe to transliterate) or "judgment" (a human must decide the target design). Read-only: this tool never modifies your files. Results are PAGED (default 200 findings) — check `incomplete`: non-null means there is more, and says how to get it. Filter with `constructs` / `classification` to work one decision at a time.

constructs.description: Return only these construct names (e.g. ["FormArray.push"]). Use it to pull one decision at a time. Filtering is announced in `incomplete`.

limit.description: Maximum findings to return. Defaults to 200. A whole workspace can be far larger than one context window, so the response is a window and says so when it is.

offset.description: Index of the first finding to return. Defaults to 0. Page with page.nextOffset.

path.description: Absolute path to a .ts file or a directory to scan recursively.

name: find_form_candidates

matchedInFile.description: Findings in this file matching the filters, before the page window.

partial.description: True when `findings` is a slice of this file, not all of it.

incomplete.description: Non-null when this response is NOT the full result, with the call that returns the rest. Null means complete. Never treat a filtered or paged list as the whole job.

totalMatched.description: Matching the filters across the scan.

totalUnfiltered.description: Findings in the scan before filters.

truncated.description: True when this page is not the whole matched set.

totalFindings.description: Findings in the whole scan, unfiltered.

title: Find Angular Reactive Forms migration candidates
